The intersection of the three sets—i.e., countries that are in the top 10 for **every** metric—is therefore **Norway, Switzerland, Iceland, Denmark, Luxembourg, United States, Australia, and Hong Kong**.*

> **Uncertainty note** – The exact thresholds for “top‑10” are drawn from the OWID‑provided grapher data on 23 Sept 2023. While the above countries satisfy the 2022 cut‑off for all three indicators, slight changes in the 2022 values (e.g., for Ireland or Singapore) could adjust the ranking. No other country is simultaneously in the top‑10 across all three OWID 2022 datasets.
